newsitem.title: UK: Cox in talks to buy Sphere Drake unit.
newsitem.headline: Cox in talks to buy Sphere Drake unit.

text.p: Britain's Cox Insurance Holdings said on Tuesday it was in talks with Bermuda-based insurer Sphere Drake about buying its Liverpool-based yacht and cargo business.

The announcement followed news on Monday that Sphere Drake was scaling back its UK operations and its activities in the London market in particular, where some of its marine insurance business had not been profitable.
Cox is the only company discussing with Sphere Drake the purchase of its Groves, John & Westrup business, which has been insuring pleasure craft for 25 years.

"The acquisition of this business would provide added strength and a complementary balance to our existing book of small craft and international cargo business," said Ian Wootton, who underwrites Lloyd's of London marine syndicate 590 -- one of seven managed by Cox.
